load-pdf-verify-page-count-facade.title: Load PDF and Verify Page Count
load-pdf-verify-page-count-facade.description: Shows how to load a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf and confirm successful loading by reading the document's page count.

check-pdf-encryption-and-toggle-protecti.title: Encrypt or Decrypt PDF Based on Encryption Status
check-pdf-encryption-and-toggle-protecti.description: The example checks whether a PDF file is already encrypted and either decrypts it with the owner password or encrypts it with user/owner passwords using AES‑256, demonstrating conditional security handling.

decrypt-pdf-owner-password.title: Decrypt PDF with Owner Password
decrypt-pdf-owner-password.description: Demonstrates how to verify if a PDF is encrypted and then decrypt it using the owner password with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

encrypt-pdf-256-aes.title: Encrypt PDF with 256‑bit AES and Set Permissions
encrypt-pdf-256-aes.description: Shows how to load a PDF, apply 256‑bit AES encryption with user and owner passwords, define print and content‑extraction permissions, and save the encrypted document.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-40.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4‑40 using Aspose.Pdf
encrypt-pdf-rc4-40.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, apply RC4‑40 encryption with user and owner passwords, set permissions, and save the encrypted document using Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-custom-privileges.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Custom Permissions
encrypt-pdf-aes256-custom-privileges.description: Demonstrates how to apply AES‑256 encryption to a PDF while specifying custom permissions such as printing and content extraction using Aspose.Pdf.

change-user-password-of-encrypted-pdf.title: Change User Password of Encrypted PDF
change-user-password-of-encrypted-pdf.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF with the existing user password and re‑encrypt it using a new user password while keeping the original owner password, permissions, and encryption algorithm.

update-owner-password-pdf.title: Update Owner Password of Encrypted PDF
update-owner-password-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to change the owner password of a password‑protected PDF while keeping the existing user password and permissions unchanged.

set-pdf-privileges-allow-printing-only.title: Set PDF Privileges: Allow Print, Block Copy
set-pdf-privileges-allow-printing-only.description: Loads a PDF, encrypts it with an owner password, and sets permissions to allow printing while disabling content extraction (copying). The modified PDF is then saved to a new file.

set-pdf-privileges-allow-form-filling-di.title: Enable Form Filling and Disable Document Assembly in PDF
set-pdf-privileges-allow-form-filling-di.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF with AES‑256 while granting only the FillForm permission, effectively allowing form filling and preventing document assembly.

disable-copying-enable-printing-pdf.title: Disable Copying While Enabling Printing in PDF
disable-copying-enable-printing-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to protect a PDF with Aspose.Pdf by allowing printing and disabling content extraction (copying) using encryption and permission settings.

remove-extended-usage-rights-from-signed.title: Remove Usage Rights from Signed PDF
remove-extended-usage-rights-from-signed.description: Demonstrates how to load a signed PDF, remove any extended usage rights, and save the resulting document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

check-pdf-extended-usage-rights.title: Check PDF for Extended Usage Rights
check-pdf-extended-usage-rights.description: Shows how to detect whether a PDF file contains extended usage rights by using the PdfFileSignature class from Aspose.Pdf.

remove-usage-rights-verify.title: Remove Usage Rights from PDF and Verify Removal
remove-usage-rights-verify.description: Demonstrates how to detect, remove, and confirm the removal of usage rights in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades. The example loads a protected PDF, strips its usage rights, saves the result, and verifies the change.

encrypt-pdf-with-password-and-capture-ex.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Permissions using Aspose.Pdf
encrypt-pdf-with-password-and-capture-ex.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying AES‑256 encryption with specific permissions, and saving the encrypted document while handling any exceptions.

set-pdf-privilege-allow-exceptions-false.title: Modify PDF Privileges and Encrypt with Aspose.Pdf
set-pdf-privilege-allow-exceptions-false.description: Demonstrates setting user and owner passwords, defining print/extract permissions, and encrypting a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while allowing exceptions to propagate.

encrypt-pdf-to-memory-stream.title: Encrypt PDF and Return as MemoryStream
encrypt-pdf-to-memory-stream.description: Loads a PDF, applies AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords, and saves the encrypted document into a MemoryStream ready for network transmission.

encrypt-pdf-from-byte-array.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 from Byte Array
encrypt-pdf-from-byte-array.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a byte array, applying AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords, and returning the encrypted PDF as a byte array.

encrypt-pdf-with-user-password.title: Encrypt PDF with User Password Only
encrypt-pdf-with-user-password.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by providing only a user password (owner password left empty) and setting specific permissions.

retrieve-pdf-encryption-algorithm.title: Retrieve PDF Encryption Algorithm with Aspose.Pdf
retrieve-pdf-encryption-algorithm.description: Shows how to detect whether a PDF is encrypted and, if so, obtain the encryption algorithm using Aspose.Pdf, employing exception handling and reflection to access version‑specific properties.

validate-pdf-encryption-and-decrypt.title: Decrypt Encrypted PDF After Encryption Check
validate-pdf-encryption-and-decrypt.description: Demonstrates how to verify if a PDF is encrypted using PdfFileInfo and, if so, decrypt it with a password via Document, saving an unencrypted copy.

batch-encrypt-pdf-files.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs with User and Owner Passwords
batch-encrypt-pdf-files.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt all PDF files in a folder using the same user and owner passwords, applying specific permissions and saving the encrypted copies to an output directory.

batch-decrypt-pdfs-owner-passwords.title: Batch Decrypt PDFs Using Owner Passwords from Config
batch-decrypt-pdfs-owner-passwords.description: Demonstrates how to read a JSON configuration file and batch‑process multiple encrypted PDFs, decrypting each with its owner password using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-update-pdf-user-passwords.title: Standardize PDF User Passwords in a Folder
batch-update-pdf-user-passwords.description: Iterates through all PDF files in a directory, removes any existing encryption and re‑encrypts each document with a common user and owner password while preserving selected permissions.

update-pdf-owner-password.title: Update Owner Password of Multiple PDFs While Preserving User Passwords
update-pdf-owner-password.description: Demonstrates how to batch‑process PDF files, re‑encrypting each with a new owner password while keeping the original user password unchanged. It uses Aspose.Pdf to load, encrypt, and save the documents safely.

conditional-pdf-encryption-based-on-file.title: Encrypt PDFs with Algorithm Based on File Name
conditional-pdf-encryption-based-on-file.description: Shows how to load PDFs, choose a CryptoAlgorithm according to naming conventions, apply passwords and permissions, encrypt the document, and save the encrypted file.

report-pdf-encryption-algorithms.title: Generate PDF Encryption Report
report-pdf-encryption-algorithms.description: Scans a directory of PDF files, determines if each document is encrypted, and writes a CSV report with the encryption status (algorithm not exposed).

encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-print-edit-privilege.title: Encrypt PDF with Print and Edit Permissions (RC4‑128)
encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-print-edit-privilege.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, combining print and edit privileges, encrypting it with the RC4‑128 algorithm, and saving the protected document.

conditional-decrypt-modify-pdf.title: Decrypt and Modify PDF with Aspose.Pdf
conditional-decrypt-modify-pdf.description: The example loads a PDF, detects if it is encrypted, decrypts it using a user password, adds a text fragment to the first page, and saves the modified file. It also shows basic usage of the PdfFileEditor facade.

encrypt-decrypt-pdf-roundtrip.title: Encrypt and Decrypt PDF with Round‑Trip Verification
encrypt-decrypt-pdf-roundtrip.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF with AES‑256 using Aspose.Pdf, decrypt it, and confirm that the original and decrypted files are identical by comparing SHA‑256 hashes.

encrypt-pdfs-with-performance-timing.title: Encrypt PDFs and Log Processing Time
encrypt-pdfs-with-performance-timing.description: Loads each PDF from a folder, applies password protection with AES‑256 encryption and specific permissions, saves the encrypted file, and logs the time taken for each encryption operation.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-upload.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Upload to Cloud Bucket
encrypt-pdf-aes256-upload.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using AES‑256 with user and owner passwords, then upload the encrypted bytes to a cloud storage bucket (simulated by a local file).

decrypt-pdf-using-owner-password-azure-k.title: Decrypt PDF Using Owner Password with Aspose.Pdf
decrypt-pdf-using-owner-password-azure-k.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF with its owner password and save it as an unencrypted file using Aspose.Pdf.

change-pdf-passwords-from-csv.title: Change User and Owner Passwords for PDFs from CSV
change-pdf-passwords-from-csv.description: Shows how to read a CSV file containing PDF paths and new passwords, then apply user and owner password encryption to each PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-stream-rc4-40.title: Encrypt PDF Stream with RC4‑40 using Aspose.Pdf
encrypt-pdf-stream-rc4-40.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF from a stream, apply RC4‑40 encryption with user and owner passwords, and return the encrypted PDF as a new stream.

pdf-encryption-summary.title: Generate PDF Encryption Summary CSV
pdf-encryption-summary.description: Scans a folder of PDF files, detects whether each file is encrypted, extracts the encryption algorithm and permission flags (when possible), and writes the results to a CSV summary file.

pdf-decryption-failure-wrong-owner-passw.title: Decrypt PDF with Incorrect Owner Password Throws Exception
pdf-decryption-failure-wrong-owner-passw.description: Demonstrates encrypting a PDF with user and owner passwords, then attempting to open it with a wrong owner password and verifying that an InvalidPasswordException is thrown.

apply-password-protection-to-pdf__v2.title: Apply Password Protection to Existing PDF
apply-password-protection-to-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF and add user and owner passwords with specific permissions using AES‑256 encryption without recreating the document object.
